name: Remixed Pixel Dungeon
tagline: Explore a pixel-art dungeon full of monsters and loot
description:
Remixed Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler with charming pixel-art graphics and a clean, simple interface. Descend through procedurally generated levels, fight monsters, and collect gear while trying to survive as deep as you can.

It's a community fork of the classic Pixel Dungeon, built to add extra features and polish on top of the original formula.
